mechanism: Fluticasone (corticosteroid) may increase risk of nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity when combined with gentamicin (aminoglycoside), and corticosteroids can mask infection symptoms while gentamicin efficacy may be reduced in immunosuppressed states.
action: Monitor renal function, audiometry, and gentamicin levels; ensure adequate hydration; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
